description: Save a page a method record cites into references/<id>.* and record it in references/opened.json, so "opened": true on that reference is backed by a snapshot the audit checks (and the quote is looked up in it). Pass text: the text your own fetch tool returned for the page; without text the server downloads it. Returns the record and the decisions.json reference entry to write.

id.description: The reference id ([@id]): letters, digits, _ and -

text.description: The page text your fetch tool returned

url.description: The page's http(s) URL (the url in references)

name: cite
title: Snapshot a cited page
